summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing daily open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares under its existing buyback programme launched 31 July 2026. Trades from 26–30 October 2026 totalled roughly 112.3 million shares at volume-weighted prices of 95.61–104.09 pence, executed through broker Goldman Sachs International; shares will be cancelled. The 30 October session showed the lowest prices (93.62–98.32p), suggesting a weaker tape. Watch execution pace, cancellation-driven share count reduction and remaining programme capacity.
